items.question: What is noobly Core?
items.answer: noobly Core is an enterprise-grade Node.js backend framework providing 13+ integrated modular services with automatic dependency injection, singleton pattern implementation, and pluggable providers for every architectural layer.

items.question: How many services does noobly Core provide?
items.answer: noobly Core provides 13 core services: Logging, Caching, Filing, Queueing, Data Service, Working, Measuring, Scheduling, Searching, Workflow, Notifying, Authentication, and AI services. Each service supports multiple provider implementations.

items.question: Is noobly Core free to use?
items.answer: Yes, noobly Core is open-source and free to use for both personal and commercial projects. Check our license for more details.

items.question: Can I use only specific services?
items.answer: Absolutely! noobly Core is fully modular. You can initialize only the services you need. The dependency injection system handles all inter-service dependencies automatically.

items.question: What providers are available?
items.answer: Each service supports multiple providers: Caching (Redis, Memcached, in-memory), Data Storage (MongoDB, SimpleDB, file-based), Filing (S3, FTP, GCP), and more. Mix and match based on your infrastructure.
